third_party/sqlite3.c, sqlite3.h
===============================

SQLite amalgamation 3.50.4 (2025-07-31), public domain.
https://www.sqlite.org/amalgamation.html

Used only to read %LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\Windows\Notifications\wpndatabase.db
read-only, so the idle strip can show which apps have recent notifications.
Compiled by build.bat with SQLITE_OMIT_LOAD_EXTENSION, SQLITE_THREADSAFE=0 and
SQLITE_OMIT_DEPRECATED; nothing else in the project depends on it.

No modifications were made to the upstream files.
